TOOLING BURST T4r — E2: the ICE treatment on the same runtime (Run C-5, E2 "fire × ice — one language"; architecture 03- § 2.2 grammars, § 2.3 alphabet, § 6 E2). task_id "T4r".

Read ONLY, in this order:
1. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/SPEC.md — § 0, § 1, § 7 rows T4a, T4b, T4e, T4h (all clauses), T4p, T4q and the new row "T4r — ice treatment" (your contract).
2. /Users/admin/Games/reincarnated-collaboration/astra_test_01/burst/BURST_RULES.md (the TOOLING row).
3. runs/C-5/specs/ice_bolt_e2.json (the spec — LAW), runs/C-5/specs/fire_bolt_e1.json (the fire twin), export/effect_kit.py, export/godot_import.py (pieces phase, burst_v1/v2, screen_px, key_states, G1 arms from T4p), oracle/peak_pieces.py (decompose — run it on the ice peak), the ice paintings (512 working copies, four-plane greyscale RGBA): runs/C-5/artifacts/VF-peak-ice-impact-01/ice_peak_01_512.png, VF-prim-ice-shard-01/ice_shard_01_512.png, VF-prim-ice-crown-01/ice_crown_01_512.png, VF-prim-ice-puff-01/ice_puff_01_512.png, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/fire_bolt_e1_B/kit.json (T4p's fire projectile kit — the template to mirror), tests/test_effect_kit.py, tests/test_godot_import.py, tests/test_vfx_picker.py (extend only).
Do not read anything else. No web. No agents. No image generation. No pip install. stdlib + Pillow + numpy + scipy ONLY; Godot for headless import/trace only (rendered = conductor's).

BUILD (legacy kits byte-identical): (1) decompose the ice peak with oracle/peak_pieces.py (spatial shards; expect 8–20 pieces; write to runs/C-5/t3/T4r/ice_pieces/); (2) kit `ice_bolt_e2` (11th Tab entry, screen_px, ice palette from the spec) mirroring fire_bolt_e1_B: travel = P_ice_shard as the head (oriented along velocity, painted tip leads) with the angular puff as a low-alpha trailing streak (alpha 0.6, scale_x ∝ speed); impact = pieces phase on the ice peak with template `burst_v1` motion (shards TRANSLATE outward on seeded radial curves — ice shatters — with rotation ≤ ±45°) but the v2 residue rule (outside-in erosion to a ragged 15–25 % residue at the origin, dissolve_order [[3],[2],[1,0]], erode_noise 0.4) — implement this as a third template name `burst_v1r` (v1 flight + v2 residue) so v1 and v2 stay byte-identical; residue then hands to (3) a ground-bound DECAL: the frost crown placed at the impact point on the ground layer (MIX, below actors, ground squash applied — it is painted foreshortened already, so scale 1.0), fading over 0.3–1.0 s (kit field decal_s), and the existing residual layer disabled for this kit; (4) contact/labels/pierce as T4f; hit-stop as T4b.
Tests (unittest, stdlib): kit validation (ice palette, template burst_v1r, decal fields); the emitted impact scene contains the shard pieces, the crown decal and no residual sprite; a headless clock trace of one cast east at a dummy (contact, burst, decal appears at contact position on the ground layer, fades by decal_s); eleven kits export byte-identically except the new one; headless import exit 0.
ACCEPTANCE (runs/C-5/t3/T4r/acceptance.json): pieces count + union exactness on the ice peak; the trace numbers; legacy byte identity; in-sandbox suite reds named.

DO NOT touch: lane/, bible/, fixtures/, briefs/, SPEC.md, BURST_RULES.md, REGISTER_CARD.md, JUDGE_RUBRIC.md, MANIFEST.sha256, receipt.schema.json, transcribe.schema.json, oracle/ (run only), export/replay.py, any test file except the three named (extend only), anything under runs/ except runs/C-5/t3/T4r/, runs/C-5/vfx_kits/v9/ice_bolt_e2/ and its registration line in kits_v9.json. Do not run git. Temporary files ONLY under runs/C-5/t3/T4r/. Write out/files.json listing every file you changed with sha256.
RETURN: the receipt (task_id "T4r"): files = every changed path with sha256; images = 0 (INTEGER); calls_used; status DELIVERED / DELIVERED_WITH_CONCERNS / FAILED with concerns listed honestly.
